title: A Theory of Atomic Beamforming
summary: Leveraging the quantum advantages of highly excited atoms, Rydberg atomic receivers (RAREs) represent a paradigm shift in microwave detection with extremely high sensitivity and broadband tunability. However, existing studies often model RAREs as isotropic point receivers and neglect the spatial variation of Rydberg atomic states within vapor cells, which can lead to inaccurate characterization of their reception patterns.
